title: Placement of Post-retirement Officers in New Jobs
what_it_is: Placement of Post-retirement Officers in New Jobs

sections.label: New unit lacks statistics
sections.summary: The passage states that because the unit is newly set up, no statistics on its work are available yet.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: As the unit is newly set up, there are no statistics available as yet on its work.

sections.label: Police officers post-retirement job training
sections.summary: About 300 Police Officers received training for their post-retirement job search over the past three years.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Over the past three years, about 300 Police Officers have received training for their post-retirement job search.

sections.label: Office career counselling and employer outreach
sections.summary: The office will provide career counselling, equip officers with in-demand skills, and reach out to prospective employers valuing their experience.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The office will also provide career counselling to prepare our officers psychologically for the job search and the transition from uniformed to civilian life; equip them with new skills that are in demand; and actively reach out to prospective employers where our officers' experience and knowledge would be valued, for example, companies which need professionals with expertise in contingency and security planning, regulatory compliance and enforcement.

sections.label: Retiring officers re-employment and CTO support
sections.summary: About 60 retiring officers are from the Police Force, about 60% are re-employed within the Home Team, and the CTO serves every retiring officer.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Of these, about 60 would be from the Police Force.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: About 60% of these retiring officers each year would be re-employed within the Home Team, whether it is back within the Police Force or other parts of the Home Team.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: The remaining 40% either did not take up the offer or were not offered re-employment for various reasons.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: The CTO endeavours to serve every single retiring officer to provide them with skills, provide them with job offers and to make sure that they are taken care of after retirement.
